item.title: AI Boom on K Street: One in Four Lobbyists Now Work on AI
item.description: A new Public Citizen report analyzes lobbying disclosures for 2025 and finds that lobbying on AI issues has skyrocketed.

item.title: DCCC Rakes in Millions From Palantir Lobbyists as Protests Target the Company’s ICE Surveillance Tools
item.description: A new FEC filing reveals the House Democrat campaign arm's latest Palantir lobbying firm fundraising haul.

item.title: AIPAC Donor-Tied Group Drops Six Figures for Foushee
item.description: A mysterious super PAC, Article One PAC, has spent $600,000 supporting Rep. Valerie Foushee in the NC-04 Democratic primary against challenger Nida Allam.

item.title: Here Is How Much AIPAC Has Funneled to Every Member of Congress
item.description: Sludge analyzed FEC data to create a searchable list of AIPAC’s donations this cycle to every member of Congress.

item.title: Trump Quietly Invested Millions in Bank Securities, Late Ethics Filing Shows
item.description: The President recently disclosed more than a hundred late trades made since May of last year, nearly all in banks and financial institutions.

item.title: Defense Contractor–Funded Think Tank Warns of Weapons Shortage After Iran Strikes
item.description: NPR listeners weren’t told the think tank receives millions from Lockheed Martin, RTX, and Northrop Grumman.

item.title: AI Lobbyists Are Flying Congressional Staffers Around the Country on Luxury Trips
item.description: The Innovative Future Collective, packed with corporate lobbyists for AI industry giants like OpenAI and Andreessen Horowitz, has been paying for House and Senate staff trips to San Francisco, Los Angeles, and London.

item.title: Democrats Criticizing ICE Are Paying Consultants Tied to Palantir
item.description: Two prominent Democratic consulting firms, Wavelength Strategy and SKDK, are owned by Stagwell, a marketing company that partnered with major ICE contractor Palantir to build an AI-driven advertising and audience-targeting system.

item.title: AIPAC Splits in Illinois Races After $20M in Spending
item.description: AIPAC-tied groups poured millions into yesterday’s Illinois Democratic primaries, much of it from undisclosed sources. Here’s how it turned out.

item.title: DOGE Operative Behind Nuclear Safety Rollbacks Sat on Industry-Backed VC Board
item.description: A key architect of Trump’s nuclear safety rollbacks simultaneously served on the board of a venture firm backed by nuclear industry investors.
